The one column for fabio:hasSubjectTerm.  rdf-config's model.yaml lists four example values under this single predicate - a descriptor/qualifier pair, a geographic term, a check tag and a topical term - to illustrate the shapes a value can take, not four properties.  Read as four columns they became four untyped `OPTIONAL { ?Pubmed fabio:hasSubjectTerm ?x }` patterns in `main`: a cross product returning N^4 rows per paper, every main column multiplied with them, all four holding the same IRIs.  One column, in its own table because the predicate is multi-valued.  The regex keeps the descriptor of a qualifier pair (D000428Q000453Q000235 -> D000428), which is the MeSH heading update-publications records.
